The `identity` block (D-021, 2026-09-22) is what makes this product THIS product — brand, visitor locale, theme trio, hero clip, the public nav (surface.nav: ordered { route, labelKey } entries after Home — the top nav, both footers and the sitemap derive from it), hidden surfaces, Organization record. This repo is the engine, so its values equal the schema defaults and are spelled out here as the worked example a downstream copies and edits (docs/ENGINE-SYNC.md §6); tests/unit/identityConfig.test.js pins them.
